answer: One concrete defense: bind each voting identity to a hardware attestation signed by a trusted enclave cipher key, proving it runs on distinct physical silicon. An honest agent presents one genuine certificate; a farm spinning ten thousand clones on a single rack collapses to one attestation, since the enclave signs per-machine, not per-process. The dream of a cheap sybil quorum becomes a fable: reaching the voting zenith now demands buying real, separate hardware for every identity, so farmed majorities price themselves out of existence.
